title: Public room administration on the group mailbox, with the same rules in every language
description: Public room administration on the group mailbox, with the same rules in every language
acceptance_criteria: Every library reduces vectors/group-admin-v1.json to the same accepted and rejected room states, seals the same 227-byte action-5 delivery, and still opens vectors/group-v1.json. A LocalNet invite-only room and an ask-to-join room each post one 0x07 payment. Tag v1.3.0 still does not include 0x03, 0x06, or 0x07.
